description.zh: 大陆度、侵蚀与峰谷耦合塑形；连接河网、湖塘与海床、普通海岛、十六群系、森林、热带草原、积雪、冻洋冰山及彩色恶地台地。
description.en: Coupled terrain, connected waters, seabed and islands; sixteen biomes, forests, savanna, snow, ocean ice and colourful badlands mesas.

tooltip.zh: 调节宏观海域的出现阈值，不表示岛屿面积百分比；0关闭海岛
tooltip.en: Controls regional thresholds, not island area percentage; zero disables islands

tooltip.zh: 岛内高低由现有山体场调节，后续恶地等配方仍可改变高度；0关闭海岛
tooltip.en: Existing massif variation sets local relief; later recipes such as badlands may modify height; zero disables islands

tooltip.zh: 同时受气候页的积雪与冻结总开关控制；关闭后仍保留冰山
tooltip.en: Also requires Enable snow and freezing; disabling floes retains icebergs

tooltip.zh: 调节连续冰体区域阈值与独立候选概率；0关闭全部冰体
tooltip.en: Controls body threshold and independent candidate probability; zero disables both

tooltip.zh: 共同控制连续冰体与独立宽丘／脊线的高度
tooltip.en: Scales continuous bodies and independent mounds or ridges

label.zh: 雪帽区域／独立雪帽比例

tooltip.zh: 简化模式按每列概率生成单格矮海草；完整模式沿用原候选密度。保存的值不自动换算
tooltip.en: Per-column probability for short seagrass in simplified mode; original candidate density in full mode. Saved values are not converted

tooltip.zh: 从地表向下；薄地形按洞顶和底部余量调整，容不下则跳过
tooltip.en: Below terrain; fitted to roof/floor clearance, skipped if too thin

label.zh: 海平面以上开凿上限（格）

tooltip.zh: 有效值不超过中心水深
tooltip.en: Effective value is capped at center depth

tooltip.zh: 关闭后跳过水系规划与塑形，保留裸露海盆；海平面仍是地形参考海拔
tooltip.en: Skip planning and water shaping, leaving bare ocean basins; sea level remains a terrain reference

label.en: Regional cold areas and summit snow

label.zh: 名义雪线（海平面以上，格）

tooltip.zh: 关闭河流与湖塘规划，保留海洋；平坦模式跳过
tooltip.en: Disable river/lake planning, retaining oceans; flat mode skips planning

tooltip.zh: 须为16的倍数；面板越界时自动调整规划窗口，窗口改变会重新规划河湖；脚本裁切须在固定规划内
tooltip.en: Multiple of 16; the panel fits out-of-bounds regions automatically, replanning rivers and lakes when the window changes; scripted crops must stay inside fixed bounds

tooltip.zh: 岸顶越高，外侧河谷越宽，最大64格
tooltip.en: Higher banks widen the outer valley, capped at 64 blocks

tooltip.zh: 控制连接骨架的连续弯曲；河网密度由成河参考面积控制
tooltip.en: Controls continuous bends; river reference area controls network density

tooltip.zh: 沿连续岸坡分配的允许下潜幅度；越大允许下降越快，不再单独挖沟。
tooltip.en: Extra depth allowed along the continuous shore slope; larger values allow faster descent without digging a separate trench.

tooltip.zh: 树木使用整树模型，草和海草使用单格模型；沙漠保留单格枯木、仙人掌和高枯草丛。关闭后加入完整花草，仙人掌为1～3格。树木、陆上植物及水草仍分别启停
tooltip.en: Whole-tree models and single-cell grass/seagrass; deserts retain single-cell dead bushes, cacti and tall dry grass. Disable for full plants and 1–3-block cacti. Tree, ground and aquatic switches remain independent

tooltip.zh: 候选树位的保留概率；还受地面条件和树冠间距限制
tooltip.en: Candidate probability, further limited by surface conditions and canopy spacing

tooltip.zh: 单树上下浮动1格，树冠额外向上延伸2格
tooltip.en: Each trunk varies by one block; foliage extends two blocks higher

tooltip.zh: 单树上下浮动1格
tooltip.en: Each trunk varies by one block

tooltip.zh: 单树上下浮动1格
tooltip.en: Each trunk varies by one block

tooltip.zh: 每12格候选树位的保留概率；仍受坡度、真实支撑及树冠间距限制
tooltip.en: Candidate probability on a 12-block grid, further limited by slope, real support and canopy spacing

tooltip.zh: 树干采用基准高度或加1格；平冠最高单元再高2格
tooltip.en: Trunks use the base height or one block higher; the highest canopy cell extends two more blocks

tooltip.zh: 普通草原保留极少量橡树；0为无树草原，不影响森林或山地
tooltip.en: Rare plains oaks; zero makes treeless plains without changing forests or mountains

tooltip.zh: 宏观暖干区域的出现强度，不表示面积百分比；0关闭自然热带草原
tooltip.en: Macro warm/dry occurrence strength, not an area percentage; zero disables natural savanna

tooltip.zh: 越高裸地越少；大于1不出现裸地，小于-1全部满足裸地规则
tooltip.en: Higher values mean less bare ground; above 1 selects none, below -1 selects all eligible ground

tooltip.zh: 每6格候选位置的保留概率；简化模式为单格，完整模式为1～3格
tooltip.en: Probability per 6-block candidate cell; one block when simplified, 1–3 blocks otherwise

tooltip.zh: 每种枯草的逐列概率；简化模式仅生成高枯草丛，完整模式包含高、矮两种
tooltip.en: Per-column probability for each dry grass type; tall only when simplified, both short and tall otherwise

tooltip.zh: 高于此处的地形被削平
tooltip.en: Terrain above is clipped

tooltip.zh: 越高越偏向宽山体，越低越突出峰谷山脊
tooltip.en: Higher favours broad bodies over PV ridges

tooltip.zh: 沙漠中的低矮沙丘；设为0关闭，河道仍沿用水系塑形
tooltip.en: Low desert dunes; zero disables them, rivers retain water-system shaping

tooltip.zh: 海面以上宽缓低地的名义高度；保留细节，强山地区不压低
tooltip.en: Nominal lowland body height above sea; detail and strong mountains are retained

tooltip.zh: 0恢复原低地计算，1完整应用；平坦模式跳过
tooltip.en: 0 restores original lowlands, 1 applies fully; flat mode skips shaping

label.zh: 大陆高度曲线（C→海平面偏移）
label.en: Continent height curve (C to sea offset)

tooltip.zh: 留空使用混合群系；整套预设会同步调整地形、水体和植被
tooltip.en: Empty uses mixed biomes; global presets also configure terrain, water and vegetation

label.zh: 山地起始高度（海平面以上）

tooltip.zh: 边界曲折程度；0 为光滑等值线
tooltip.en: Boundary wiggle; 0 gives smooth contours

tooltip.zh: 每格升高多少格算陡坡
tooltip.en: Rise per block that exposes rock
